languageReview: English and Telugu candidate copy requires product/legal and fluent Telugu review; no send, template approval or translation validation claimed.
rules: Only committed state can trigger a factual success notification
Recheck current object/tenant/recipient permission and purpose/channel consent immediately before send
TTL and retry budgets are OPEN approved policy inputs; no arbitrary numeric promise
Drop expired/stale actionable offers; deep links must fetch latest authenticated state
No raw address, phone, photo, government evidence, access token, complaint narrative or competing provider identity in transport payload
Provider receipts are delivery facts, never assignment or customer consent
All listed channels are candidates subject to actual platform/provider approval; staff remains private web
Identical logical event/recipient/channel/template has one delivery identity; no cross-channel repeated command
